subject: One friend needs this app tonight
preview_text: You know who it is. Send them this before 2AM panic hits.
body_paragraphs: I know you've been there. Staring at a blank page at 2AM, heart racing, deadline in hours. That one friend of yours? They're living that right now.
You've got the app. You know how fast it kills that panic. But there's someone in your life—maybe a roommate, a study group buddy, or that kid who always asks for help—who's drowning without it.
Share your referral link in the app. They get a free thesis starter. You get a permanent upgrade. It's the kind of help you wish someone gave you before you learned the hard way.
Open Thesis Generator and find your referral link. P.S. The person you're thinking of? Send it now. They'll thank you at 2AM tomorrow.
